name: Other shellfish
summary: Sò kẹp, sò dương (also sò gật), sò gạo, hầu, bàn mai, điệp nữ, phi phi, and xâng (also sâng) each have their own line on the harbor boards.
howToEat: Order them by weight; one board sells hầu by the piece. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4, đường Núi Ngọc, and the quay kitchens at Bến Bèo.
